definitions.explanation: A day off granted to an employee as compensation for having worked on a regular day off or holiday.

examples.english: I'll take a compensatory day off.

examples.japanese: {土曜日|どようび}に{出勤|しゅっきん}したので、{月曜日|げつようび}に{代休|だいきゅう}をもらった。
examples.english: Since I worked on Saturday, I got a compensatory day off on Monday.

examples.japanese: {忙|いそが}しくて{代休|だいきゅう}がなかなか{消化|しょうか}できない。
examples.english: I'm so busy that I can't manage to use up my compensatory days off.

notes: Common collocations include {代休|だいきゅう}を{取|と}る (to take a comp day), {代休|だいきゅう}をもらう (to be given a comp day), and {代休|だいきゅう}を{消化|しょうか}する (to use up comp days). Legally distinct from {振替休日|ふりかえきゅうじつ} (transferred holiday), which is scheduled in advance before working on a day off. {代休|だいきゅう} is granted after the fact, usually at a later date chosen by the employee or employer.
